verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts is a fair question for an online government filing portal like e-FRRO, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that any such limits are published. The probes show only that the root URL returns a JavaScript shell with almost no readable text (12 characters) and that the long-published entry path now returns 404, so no up-front disclosure of hours, limits, or timeouts could be found.
